name: Layer tree and fixtures
description: LayerTree<Payload>, the one layer tree: LayerPayload, LayerNode (nesting, hide, lock, a follow link), LayerRow (the layers panel's flat rows from rows(expanded:)), ArrangeStep and TreeRefusal; move, arrange, group, ungroup, duplicate and the follow link are stubs for EK-12 and EK-13. Fakes/KernelFixtures.swift holds the shared fixtures: tree200 (200 nodes, seven roots, groups three deep, one hidden, one locked) and cards (the snapping packet's page in Desktop). Fakes/FakeCanvasDocument.swift is the command catalog's fake app: a headless document of named rects with its six commands plus undo and redo, the file-flow commands and the eight fill commands (each rect an optional fill in its own box, left out of the JSON when nil, and an optional ShapeSpec from shape.draw, the same way), its fixture, and CommandCatalog.empty for an app that has adopted no command yet.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
